Scopes are augments crafted by engineers. They can be applied to bows, crossbows and guns to boost damage, critical strike rating, ranged haste rating, ranged hit rating, or something else. Scopes function like an Enchantment in that they are a permanent augmentation and that only one can be applied to the item at any given time. While the scope itself can only be created by someone skilled in Engineering, the act of applying it to the ranged weapon can be done by anyone who meets the base level requirement (and, in the case with Flintlocke's Woodchucker, class requirement) of the item. :Note: This list is accurate as of Patch 4.2.0. * Items tagged with require The Burning Crusade to craft o

Schools of Red Snapper can be found all along the Crystalbrook river, which divides the draenei starting area Ammen Vale from the rest of Azuremyst Isle. The red snappers are an important source of food for the nearby draenei camp Azure Watch, and one of the draenei (named Diktynna) has been fishing here to provide for the camp. However, murlocs have recently started causing trouble in the area, and have injured Diktynna so that she can no longer do her job. Adventurous young draenei passing through the area of Ammen Ford may want to pay her a visit (see Red Snapper - Very Tasty!). Diktynna possesses a special Draenei Fishing Net which allows her to catch many Red Snapper from these schools.

Schnottz's crew (simply referred to as troopers and employees) is an organization led by Commander Schnottz operating in Uldum. The group is at least partially funded by private businessmen. They are referred to as over-aggressive pillagers. The crew has a strict policy, one that is taken most seriously: the troops are to dress in official uniform at all times. This helps with organization, friendly fire incidents are reduced, and it keeps the troops looking wonderful. This that what they call "". Scorched Sands Outcasts are Zandalari trolls located across the Scorched Sands Outpost in Vol'dun. During Arming the Tribe, they are all equipped with weapons to fight off Mojambo's attacking gang, and after Mojambo (quest) they can all be seen standing in the Scorched Sands Arena.

He is stronger than most of the other pterrordax hatchlings on the ridge and holds his head high despite the many scars and wounds that mar his body. After adventurers kill Hakid, they use the beastbreaker's key to free the Scion and escort him back to Rakjan the Unbroken at Rakjan's Peak, where he subsequently remains.

's stable.]] The Scorched Sands Outpost is a camp nestled in a set of ruins in southern Vol'dun, just west of Zul'Ahjin and southwest of Atul'Aman. To the south lies the Arid Basin, while following the road west leads to the Exiles' Enclave, Camp Lastwind, and eventually the Port of Zem'lan. The outpost is home to a tribe of Zandalari outcasts led by Razgaji, who is standing at the nearby Scorched Sands Arena. Despite frequent sandstorms and short supplies, the exiles here have begun to herd alpacas among the harsh terrain. The Scorched Sands Arena is a ruined troll arena located on the north side of the Scorched Sands Outpost in southern Vol'dun, just west of Zul'Ahjin and southwest of Atul'Aman. Marauders holing up here regularly steal supplies from the nearby outpost. Razgaji, the leader of the Scorched Sands Outpost, can be found standing on the arena's southern edge and asks adventurers to help him convince the rival gang leader Mojambo and his henchmons to leave. While Mojambo agrees to leave, he also promises to return and kill Razgaji. The Scholar's Den was a base of attendants in Korthia. After the Jailer pulled the realm into the Maw, the invading mawsworn wiped out the locals. The area is bordered clockwise from the north by Keeper's Respite, the edge of the zone to the east, the Path of Understanding to the southeast, Seeker's Quorum to the south, and Mauler's Outlook to the west. There's also a mouth to the Caverns of Contemplation at that leads beneath the Keeper's Respite.
